machine: gb10 (see MACHINES.md; shared box - co-tenant organs run throughout: STT/TTS/embedding/recall services resident on the GPU and CPUs; all timed cells at scheduler niceness 19)
gpu: NVIDIA GB10 (co-tenant GPU residency; no GPU lane in this campaign - the re-conduct pipeline is CPU-only)

niceness.set_via: os.setpriority on the runner process (absolute, inherited by every timed child)

pinning.produce_lane: taskset -c 5-9,15,16 (seven Cortex-X925 cores; multi-threaded pipeline) - the sec2 produce-lane mask

onesys-driver.note: shared-subtree producer through the one-system conductor with the qtsl ground provider in-loop; producer pins as stamped in ../MANIFEST.json (mtk main@09dccea1b, qtsl provider f0ecbf32d03a, geolog 83ebe88d5007)

glc-check.note: built from the pinned checkout at QTSL_REV f0ecbf32d03af43921a11ee7e0aee7a35d51822d (exactly what `make supermartingales-glc` builds)

protocol: produce: 1 flagged warmup + 10 measured repeats per container, serial, whole re-conduct wall per invocation (committed reference listings through forest merge + in-loop check + deterministic seal), emitted container byte-identical to the committed sha on every repeat, --split-budget-ops 1000000 (the manifest's stated production knob); geolog: 10 accepted serial single-container checker repeats per container, no warmup, exact per-relation claim tally gated (allForwardDiffBernCoeffsSatisfyP=4800); page cache warm-by-protocol (shared box, no cache dropping, no cold-cache claim)
per_row_load_samples: 1-minute load average recorded immediately before and after every produce row (the receipt rows' loadavg_before_1min / loadavg_after_1min fields); range observed across the campaign 2.35-7.21
spread_rule: (max-min)/median > 0.25 flagged; no cell flagged (produce worst: persist_2d__uniform 0.203; geolog worst: persist_2d__gaussian_p1 0.062)
